  • docs: sync archived documentation versions with release tags [skip release]

✅ Tests:
  • tests: EC2 instances in the guard and ARN/tag tests use a fixed image ID instead of moto's default AMIs, which an earlier test can switch off (MOTO_EC2_LOAD_DEFAULT_AMIS); the tests now pass alone and in any order
  • tests: run the v1.2.0 doc claims for exit codes 5 and 6, template provenance columns, session expiry and --resume
  • tests: enrichment handler tests use a real client, since operations chosen by name now pass the read-only policy check
  • tests: the checker's S3 upload is stored with SSE-S3 (ServerSideEncryption=AES256), as the published policy's PutObject condition requires
  • tests: no CLI module, template runner or settings key can reach the write helpers or turn the guard off
  • tests: --template reports (built-in templates and a JSON template by path with every field and raw environment columns) hide secret values in Excel, Word and the tag-compliance JSON (moto run)
  • tests: e2e expectations follow the integrated branch (Secrets Manager is listed by ListSecrets, so the Tagging-API fallback is shown with a log group; strict config loader wording)
  • tests: e2e tests for billing validation, tagging-API fallback, config validation and credential failures
  • tests: end-to-end CLI tests against moto, duplicate-resolution test, README
  • tests: isolate home, credentials and network; keep log files out of the repo; stop leaked monitor threads
  • tests: every discovered row names the API that returned it and no predicted row appears
  • tests: discovery limit from the account limit, partial accounts, region discovery, resume round trip with the real state layer, coverage in the JSON output
  • tests: load, validate and run all eight built-in templates offline against moto
  • tests: S3 upload failure handling
  • tests: pagination, ECS services, partitions, classification and region discovery

📝 Other Changes:
  • changelog: v1.2.0 upgrade notes (new IAM actions, first change report after the upgrade, opt-in exit codes, kept service names), the behaviour review fixes (kept v1.1.4 service names, ID-keyed maps in one cell, quieter first change report, ordered lists, usage counters, one log line per message, analysis columns) and the security review fixes (more masked fields, more guard denials, policy check for operations chosen by name, legacy scripts under the guard, cloudtrail:LookupEvents dropped, 122 read actions)
  • Footer: a long link label wraps inside its column on a 320px screen [skip release]
  • reporting: tag keys with ':' or '/' (aws:cloudformation:stack-name, kubernetes.io/...) keep one column each; only maps keyed by UUIDs, long hex IDs, ARNs or numbers become one JSON cell
  • state: change tracking ignores usage counters and clocks (EFS SizeInBytes, Secrets Manager LastAccessedDate, Backup NumberOfRecoveryPoints, EMR NormalizedInstanceHours, RDS LatestRestorableTime), which changed on every run
  • reporting: the document generator's Excel builder replaces characters Excel forbids in sheet names with '-', like the default and template writers
  • enrichment: operations chosen by name pass the read-only policy check (check_client_call) before the call, also without the global guard (security review B1; needs inventag/security from audit/review-security 48b30a9)
  • logging: each CLI log line is printed once; comprehensive discovery warnings use the CLI format and reach --log-file (the inventory and the legacy checker no longer add a root handler under the CLI)
  • state: change tracking keeps the order of Lambda layers, Auto Scaling termination policies and CloudFront cache behaviors, where order is configuration; other lists stay unordered
  • state: the first change report after upgrading from v1.1.4 no longer lists every resource as modified (source, sources and detail_level are route fields; a Tagging API row that is now a service API row with the same ARN compares tags only)
  • reporting: a raw_data map keyed by IDs, ARNs or numbers (Secrets Manager SecretVersionsToStages) is one JSON cell, not one column per resource
  • discovery: services v1.1.4 already reported keep their service name and sheet (ELASTICFILESYSTEM, STATES, COGNITO-IDP, ELASTICMAPREDUCE, KAFKA, ES), so a resource found by its service API or by the Tagging API lands on one sheet
  • templating: the Name column shows the ID for Lambda functions, IAM roles and KMS aliases, as the standard report does
  • Phone menu: Back to main menu moves focus to the first main menu item [skip release]
  • Tables: code in cells breaks only at safe points; first column may use half the width [skip release]
  • 404 page: footer shows the language of the address [skip release]
  • security: the guard denies reads whose purpose is a signed URL, a file or document body, command output or a stored definition with secrets (SSM GetDocument/GetCommandInvocation, API Gateway exports, Data Pipeline definitions, support and Connect attachments, and others), and cognito-identity GetId, which creates an identity; signed, download and upload URL fields are masked; test that every deny-list entry names a real operation
  • security: mask more secret fields found by sweeping every operation dynamic discovery may call (Token, HEC/Grafana/join tokens, access and refresh tokens, presigned URLs, activation codes, DMS certificate wallets, EMR on EKS job arguments); test that a changed secret is not revealed by snapshots or the change report
  • security: drop cloudtrail:LookupEvents from the read-only IAM policy (no running code calls it; it returns event records with request parameters); 122 actions; tests that no action grants content and every table operation of a scan is covered
  • scripts: the legacy scripts run under the read-only guard with owner-only files and redacted logs; the inventory script uploads with --s3-bucket through one PutObject-only client with SSE-S3 and a checked bucket name, and runs the converter without a shell
  • security: check_client_call() applies the read-only policy to operations chosen by name, also without the global guard; review tests for guard placement (threads, resources, new and assumed-role sessions, pricing/cost/analyzer clients), the four unsigned sign-in exchanges, presigning, parameter rules, per-client PutObject, formula cells and path checks in template output, and credential handling
  • security: mask Glue trigger and job-run arguments, CloudFormation output values, stack set template bodies, connection strings and secret fields inside JSON text; log redaction covers the same fields; planted-secrets test covers them in Excel, Word, snapshots, JSON and CSV output, resume checkpoints and the debug log
  • site: search index skips related-page tiles and card grids [skip release]
  • scripts: google_live_test.py, a live test of Google Sheets and Docs output for the owner to run, with offline tests of its read-back checks
  • core: coverage metadata tolerates account contexts without a coverage list; tests follow the checker's real API and record every STS client in the credential-timeout check
  • discovery: SQS ListQueues sends a page size so queues beyond 1,000 per region are listed; monthly_spend carries the billed service amount like service_monthly_spend; two-page test for every listing operation of the service table; xfail markers removed
  • scripts: add benchmark_scan.py (synthetic moto estate; time, API calls, memory)
  • scripts: add live_smoke_test.py for a read-only check against a real AWS account
  • security: the read-only IAM policy lists the actions of the new services, account:ListRegions and ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces; shipped policy file regenerated
  • cli: --bom-config uses the typed settings loader (wrong types stop with the key named); accounts, tag-mapping and service-description files are read with the strict loader (UTF-8 with or without BOM, duplicate keys, empty files)
  • analysis: network and security analyzers read VPC, subnet and group IDs from the raw API data (EC2, Lambda VpcConfig, RDS, ElastiCache, ELB); the CLI's Network and Security sheets count every resource, not only VPC rows; end-to-end test
  • core: _run_compliance_analysis calls the checker with policy= and check_compliance(), and makes no AWS call
  • s3: the lifecycle helper refuses to write unless allow_bucket_writes=True and no longer opens the guard; CI/CD integration passes the opt-in; the development CI/CD script no longer changes bucket lifecycle by default
  • security: log redaction uses the shared deny-list (CloudFormation parameters, Glue arguments and connection properties, name/value environment lists); end-to-end test plants secrets and checks every artifact and the debug log
  • cli: one exit-code list (inventag/exit_codes.py); --fail-if-empty is 6 on both the default and the --template path, 4 stays the risk threshold
  • core: the per-account time limit drives discovery's own limit, a timed-out account keeps its partial results and counts as failed, regions come from discover_regions(), coverage ledger and source reach the report data, snapshots get the real retention, scope and previous-snapshot lookup
  • security: one deny-list for secret values (inventag/security/secret_values.py), used at discovery, in core, by every report writer, in snapshots and checkpoints; mask again after BOM enrichment
  • reporting: hide secret values before any report is written, write reports atomically, unique valid sheet names with a warning, XML-safe text, Word notes say how many rows are missing
  • reporting: map resources to VPCs, subnets and security groups with the analyzers' real methods (the old per-resource calls did not exist) and give the analyzers every resource
  • reporting: add a strict settings-file loader and typed --bom-config settings (BOM, duplicate keys, empty files, wrong types)
  • templating: read JSON templates as JSON (tabs and surrogate escapes work), report deeply nested files as errors
  • reporting: Excel sheets survive control characters, odd or missing service names and long values; layout files reject duplicate keys; legacy input is read as UTF-8 with or without BOM
  • templating: count invalid tags by full key, strip control characters and cap Excel cells, treat any dotted reference as a path, read backslash paths the same everywhere, match schema patterns whole, warn when --tag-mappings or --service-descriptions are not shown by a template, expose empty result and --fail-if-empty support
  • reporting: keep resources from different accounts apart when deduplicating, keep input order after parallel enrichment, fix IDs parsed from ARNs
  • reporting: keep builder warnings and sheet names per thread
  • google output: check cell and column limits first, size Sheets requests, retry on rate limit, pass supportsAllDrives, name the incomplete file when a call fails
  • reporting: Excel and Word builders handle odd names and text, save atomically, cap and explain cut rows, and Word tables build in linear time
  • cli: warn when an accounts file with access keys can be read by other users
  • core: apply --credential-timeout to AssumeRole and the profile and default-credential identity checks
  • cli: opt-in --fail-on-account-error (exit 5) and --fail-if-empty (exit 6); --resume, --state-retention-days, --state-max-snapshots; stop on conflicting flags
  • core: keep finished accounts when one times out; account checkpoints for --resume; pass failed accounts to the snapshot
  • core: enforce the per-account time limit, and fail the run when a report format fails
  • security: remove secret values from discovered resources before reports, snapshots and logs
  • security: setup_cross_account_roles() refuses to write to IAM without allow_iam_writes=True
  • security: let SSO and web-identity sign-in pass the read-only guard; block more secret-returning reads, secret parameters and local presigning
  • discovery: table-driven listing for 22 more services; fix WorkMail result key
  • discovery: remove predicted rows; coverage ledger and source labels; discovery time limit as a parameter
  • comprehensive discovery: follow every page, list ECS services in every cluster, work in China and GovCloud, keep resources in their own service
  • discovery: mask values that can hold secrets before they reach state or reports
  • discovery: no invented rows by default; drop the generic fallback that only added AWS-owned items; fix dynamic discovery rows
  • discovery: one retry config and thread-safe client creation; read Lambda, RDS and stack details in their own region
  • tag mapping: read AWS list-form tags; do not report a missing tag's default as a validation error; tests
  • arn utils: partitions for iso and sovereign-cloud regions; ARN and tag tests for GovCloud, China, global services and odd resource parts
  • service enrichment: do not send empty ARN parameters in guessed calls
  • security analyzer: rate port ranges, all-traffic and ICMP rules correctly, keep prefix-list rules, find unused groups from network interfaces, NACL IPv6
  • service descriptions: a user entry now wins over the built-in description; template still honoured
  • network analyzer: route-table based public subnets, pagination, IPv6-only subnets, empty-VPC check from network interfaces
  • scripts: the legacy tag compliance checker passes allow_write=True when --s3-bucket is given
  • compliance: package docstring says what the package does and does not do
  • compliance: checker ignores aws: system tags, reports unenforced policy fields, fixes BOM status column, ARN parsing, and refuses S3 upload unless allow_write=True
  • state: per-account partial result store (state-layer part of resume), exports
  • state: atomic snapshot writes, secret redaction, configurable retention, account-aware and order-insensitive comparison
  • Hidden menu button: icon square with a gutter so it never covers text; 404 buttons use the page font [skip release]
  • Tables: wrapping rules no longer depend on the overflow flag; checks wait for fonts [skip release]
  • Tables: first column keeps a readable width on phones [skip release]
  • Breadcrumb pressed state; check accepts group role [skip release]
  • Check script: pressed state, search, tables, banner and phone menu checks; table group role, back label names its section [skip release]
  • Hidden menu button stays in view; back-to-top moves to the left on phones [skip release]
  • 404 page: actions, language from the address, search opens with the address words [skip release]
  • Copy buttons: visible failure state, one 2 s timing, no width jump [skip release]
  • Read-aloud: starting, failed and no-voice states with visible and announced feedback, Pause that works everywhere, speed change keeps the place, sticky controls, focus kept [skip release]
  • Phone drawer: fixed header height, language button in the header, focus kept when sections open and close; sidebar hide and show keep focus [skip release]
  • Tables: framed scroller with edge tabs, sticky row label, named focusable region, readable last column on phones [skip release]
  • Search: loading, searching and failed states, focus trap, inert page behind, Escape from anywhere, announced counts, Close button on phones [skip release]
  • Pressed state for controls, rows and cards; primary hover keeps its fill; cookie banner compact on phones and shows the current choice [skip release]
  • ci: example version in the PR label hint uses the v prefix [skip release]
  • ci: print InvenTag versions with the v prefix in release and docs deploy logs, release heading, bump commit subject and release notes [skip release]
  • i18n: refresh the translated current-version label to v1.1.4 [skip release]
  • site: fix a literal escape sequence in the landing heading [skip release]
  • ci: the sync job summary no longer fails when the run is not a dry run [skip release]
  • ci: the docs archive jobs pull with --autostash, so generated files left by the build do not stop the push [skip release]
